scope: No-training Radon/ridge neural encoding of linear PDE propagators, numerical nonlinear evolution, dimensional scaling, low-dimensional physical inverse problems.
claims_requirements: No forward interior labels used to fit weights
Exact or independent refined references only for verification
State analytic propagation vs numerical evolution vs optimization separately
Heat and NS snapshots use time-varying readouts; wave is fixed four-input network
Whole-space or periodic domains; arbitrary walls and turbulent accuracy not established
Six-parameter inverse least squares disclosed separately from explicit readout construction
validation_note: All scripts parsed; all result JSON parsed with NaN/Infinity rejected; physical/autograd/refinement checks are recorded in the component result directories.

quill_followup.interior_convention: N interior centers, n_cells=N-1, R=ceil(sqrt(N)) per side; total M*(N+2R)
quill_followup.scalar_boundary_diagnostic_convention: quill_boundary standalone follows paper N interval cells; see boundary_method.md
quill_followup.ns_scope: Encoding and direction pruning of saved Fourier states. No new fluid evolution, no native neural PDE solver.
qualifications: empirical sampled relative norms, not certified continuous L2
best tested settings, not global optimum
64^3 balanced NS comparison is a triangle-inequality upper bound, not new direct measurement

native_dynamics_followup.method: theta_dot=E A F(S theta); explicit real-data analysis and QUILL encoding; cubic local-map control; direct finite time Taylor construction
native_dynamics_followup.reference_policy: No external solution enters dynamics or Taylor construction; references run only afterward for validation
native_dynamics_followup.outcome: Burgers and short smooth interacting 3D Navier-Stokes evolve without training or a readout linear solve. Native Fourier-bridged method is modified spectral evolution, not a demonstrated classical-solver speedup.
native_dynamics_followup.taylor_scope: T=.05, degree12; finite K5 projected ODE, no production time marching. Local analytic convergence, not universal full-PDE closed form.
limitations: spatial quadrature and spectral intermediates retained
dense O(PQ) inference/operator storage or cached reduced fields
cost comparisons are single-run diagnostics not tuned benchmarks

pinn_capability_followup.scope: Nonlinear Burgers sparse-data three-physical-parameter inversion; nonlinear square-Dirichlet steady PDE using actual QUILL ridge fields and preconditioned residual updates.
pinn_capability_followup.inverse_solve: Explicitly disclosed 24x3 physical-parameter least-squares Jacobian; tangent RK4 sensitivities verified.
pinn_capability_followup.reference_policy: Forward elliptic reference computed after native solves; inverse accepts only sparse synthetic measurements from separate refined classical dynamics, withheld fields excluded from inference.
limitations: elliptic reference shares sine discretization family
uncertainty and arbitrary geometry not implemented
validation: noise repeats and identifiability negative control
elliptic spatial refinement and off-grid physical residual
independent audit of ridge derivatives and quadrature
native construction+solve guarded against FFT or global linear algebra solves
